verdict.rationale: ucp.dev says the complete UCP specification, documentation and reference implementations are hosted in a public GitHub repository under multi-vendor governance. A runtime probe confirmed ucp.dev serves a versioned spec index with dated releases (2026-08-25, 2026-04-08), and Shopify's live MCP server reports the matching 2026-08-25 version header. Another probe showed a self-generated profile could create a real cart keylessly, so reading and implementing the protocol needs no agreement. missing for 10: an explicit statement of the spec's license terms confirming no contributor or usage agreement is required, and full conformance by Shopify's own implementation (it ignores the spec's webhook_url profile field).
